Two large, brown, '''long-necked creatures''' were seen peacefully grazing in the [[Endorian Grasslands]], until they were distracted by the sight of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] being carried by flying [[Gupin/Legends|Gupins]] overhead, and the creatures then looked on in bemusement at the unusual sight.<ref name="1-08" />
